result.notes: Created fvf.hpp, fvf.cpp, fvf_fi.F90 under software/mcfm/src/W2jet/. Original fvf.f moved to deprecated/. The function Fvf(st,j1..j6,za,zb) translates to C++ using i3m (Need.hpp), Lsm1_2mh/Lsm1_2me (Need.hpp), t (W1jet.hpp), and FArray2D for the za/zb arrays. Statement function zab2 becomes a lambda. hqpqbmgpgm and hqpqbmgpgp branches preserved exactly. CMakeLists.txt not touched.

Produced atree.cpp, atree.hpp, atree_fi.f90 in software/mcfm/src/W2jet/; moved original atree.f to deprecated/. Key decisions: (1) The character(len=2) st argument is split into two c_char values (st1, st2) in the wrapper to satisfy bind(C) requirements, reassembled as std::string in C++. (2) The Fortran statement function tree is translated to a C++ lambda capturing za, zb, s, and t by reference. (3) t() is imported via #include <W1jet.hpp> (already translated). (4) Both denominator expressions retain their explicit parentheses: / (s*s*t). (5) All three crossing variants (pp, pm, sl) and their argument orderings match the source. CMakeLists.txt not touched; atree_fi.f90 and atree.cpp to be wired in by the serial Integrate step.
